en-e1-l1.title: Mkpụrụedemede na ụda mbụ
en-e1-l1.concept: Ọ dị mfe icheta okwu ma ị mara ụda mbụ na mkpụrụedemede mbụ ya. Kpọọ ụda ahụ n'olu ma soro gụọ.

en-e1-l2.title: Okwu ekele
en-e1-l2.concept: Mgbe i zutere onye, sị **Hello**, mgbe unu na-ekewa, sị **Goodbye**. Kwuo aha gị site na **My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Ọnụọgụgụ na agba
en-e1-l3.concept: Mụta ọnụọgụgụ dị ka one, two, three... na okwu agba dị ka red, blue, yellow...

en-e1-l4.title: Ezinụlọ
en-e1-l4.concept: Ha bụ okwu a na-eji akpọ ezinụlọ dị ka mother (nne), father (papa), grandmother (nne nne), baby (nwa ọhụrụ).

en-e1-l5.title: Okwu klaasị
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Gbalịa ikwu okwu ndị a na-eji n'klaasị n'asụsụ Bekee.

en-e2-l1.title: Aha anụmanụ na ihe
en-e2-l1.concept: Okwu na-egosi aha dị ka rabbit (oke ọhịa), bird (nnụnụ), fish (azụ) ka a na-akpọ **aha**.

en-e2-l2.title: Okwu na-egosi mmegharị
en-e2-l2.concept: Okwu na-egosi mmegharị dị ka jump (awụli elu), run (agba ọsọ), eat (iri nri) ka a na-akpọ **okwu ngwaa**.

en-e2-l3.concept: **I like ...** pụtara 'Masịrị m ...', **I have ...** pụtara 'Enwere m ...'.

en-e2-l4.title: Ime ahịrịokwu dị mkpụmkpụ
en-e2-l4.concept: Jiri **am** na-eso I, jiri **are** na-eso You. Ahịrịokwu na-esote usoro 'onye → otu ọ dị/ihe ọ na-eme'.

en-e2-l5.title: Ịgụ ederede dị mkpụmkpụ
en-e2-l5.concept: Mgbe i na-agụ ederede, buru ụzọ chọta okwu dị n'ajụjụ ahụ n'ime ederede.

en-e3-abc1.title: Mkpụrụedemede ukwu na obere
en-e3-abc1.concept: Mkpụrụedemede nwere **ndị ukwu** na **ndị nta**. Ọtụtụ ụzọ ha dị iche, ya mere cheta ha n'otu n'otu. Mkpụrụedemede yiri onwe ha dị ka b, d, p, q chọrọ nlezianya.

en-e3-l1.title: Ime ahịrịokwu
en-e3-l1.concept: Ahịrịokwu na-esote usoro 'onye → ihe ọ na-eme → ihe'. Tinye **-s** n'okwu ngwaa na-eso He, She na aha mmadụ.

en-e3-l2.title: Nnọchiaha
en-e3-l2.concept: Kama aha, ị nwere ike iji **He** (ya, nwoke), **She** (ya, nwaanyị), **It** (ya, ihe), **They** (ha), **We** (anyị).

en-e3-l3.title: Oge ugbu a na gara aga
en-e3-l3.concept: Maka ihe na-eme ugbu a ma ọ bụ ugboro ugboro, jiri **ụdị oge ugbu a**; maka ihe gara aga, jiri **ụdị oge gara aga** nke e tinyere **-ed** n'ọnụ okwu ngwaa.

en-e3-l4.title: Ihe a na-eme kwa ụbọchị
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Gbalịa ikwu ihe ị na-eme kwa ụbọchị n'asụsụ Bekee.

en-e3-l5.title: Ịghọta ederede
en-e3-l5.concept: Gụọ ederede ahụ ma chọta onye, mgbe, na ihe a mere.

en-e3-snd1.title: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ụda na ntụpọ okwu
en-e3-snd1.concept: Ụda mbụ nke okwu na mkpụrụedemede mbụ nwere njikọ. Chọta okwu ndị na-amalite n'otu ụda ka ị mụta mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ụda na ntụpọ okwu. Mkpụrụedemede abụọ dị ka ph nwekwara ike ịkpọ ụda f.

en-e4-l1.title: Oge ugbu a, gara aga na ọdịnihu
en-e4-l1.concept: Maka ihe na-eme ugbu a na ihe na-eme ugboro ugboro, jiri **ụdị oge ugbu a**; maka ihe gara aga, jiri **-ed**; maka ihe ga-eme n'ọdịnihu, jiri **will + okwu ngwaa n'ụdị mbụ**.

en-e4-l2.title: Ajụjụ na mgbochi
en-e4-l2.concept: Ajụjụ na-amalite na **Do/Does**, ma mgbe i na-ekwu 'mba', jiri **don't/doesn't**.

en-e4-l3.title: Okwu na-egosi udi na mmetụta
en-e4-l3.concept: Ha bụ okwu na-akọwa ọdịdị ma ọ bụ mmetụta dị ka big (nnukwu), small (obere), hot (ọkụ), cold (oyi).

en-e4-l5.title: Ịgụ ederede dị mkpụmkpụ
en-e4-l5.concept: Chọta n'ederede ahụ onye, ebe, na ihe a mere, wee zaa.

en-e5-l1.title: Okwu ntụaka, ọtụtụ na There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Tupu ụda ụdaume, jiri **an**; tupu ụda mgbochiume, jiri **a**. Maka otu, jiri **There is**; maka ọtụtụ, jiri **There are**.

en-e5-l2.title: Okwu ntụnyere
en-e5-l2.concept: Mgbe i na-atụnyere abụọ, jiri **-er + than**; maka kacha ... jiri **the -est**. Maka okwu ogologo, jiri **more**.

en-e5-l3.title: Okwu ọdịnihu
en-e5-l3.concept: Maka ihe ga-eme n'ọdịnihu, jiri **will + okwu ngwaa n'ụdị mbụ** ma ọ bụ **be going to + okwu ngwaa n'ụdị mbụ**.

en-e5-l4.title: Idegharị ahịrịokwu
en-e5-l4.concept: Tinye **not / don't / doesn't / didn't** n'ahịrịokwu mgbochi, ma tinye **Are / Do / Does** n'isi ahịrịokwu ajụjụ.

en-e5-l5.title: Ịghọta ederede
en-e5-l5.concept: Ederede ogologo dị mfe ịgụ ma ị chọta onye, ebe, oge, na ihe dị ka ị na-edepụta akara n'okpuru ha.

en-e6-l1.title: Nchịkọta oge niile
en-e6-l1.concept: Maka ihe na-eme ugbu a, jiri **be + -ing**; maka ihe gara aga, jiri **ụdị oge gara aga**; maka ihe ga-eme n'ọdịnihu, jiri **will / be going to**.

en-e6-l2.concept: Okwu ngwaa n'ụdị mbụ na-eso **can** (nwere ike), **must** (aghaghị), **should** (kwesịrị), **may** (nwere ike ikwe).

en-e6-l3.title: Ịgbasa okwu
en-e6-l3.concept: Ọ bụrụ na i mụọ okwu nwere otu ihe pụtara na okwu megidere onwe ha ọnụ, okwu gị ga-aba ụba okpukpu abụọ.

en-e6-l4.title: Okwu njikọ
en-e6-l4.concept: Jiri **because** (ihe kpatara), **so** (nsonaazụ), **but** (ọdịiche), **if** (ọ bụrụ na), **when** (mgbe) jikọọ ahịrịokwu.

en-e6-l5.title: Ịgụ paragraf
en-e6-l5.concept: Gụọ ederede nwere ọtụtụ ahịrịokwu wee chọta onye, mgbe, na ihe kpatara ya, wee zaa.

en-e6-pun1.title: Mkpụrụedemede ukwu na akara ahịrịokwu
en-e6-pun1.concept: Ahịrịokwu na-amalite na **mkpụrụedemede ukwu** ma na-ejedebe na **akara ahịrịokwu** kwesịrị ekwesị. Ahịrịokwu nkịtị na-eji ntụpọ (.), ajụjụ na-eji akara ajụjụ (?), ma ihe ịtụnanya ma ọ bụ mmetụta siri ike na-eji akara mkpu (!). Aha mmadụ na I bụ mkpụrụedemede ukwu mgbe niile.

en-e6-seq1.title: Ịmata usoro ihe mere
en-e6-seq1.concept: Ọ bụrụ na i chọta okwu na-egosi usoro dị ka **First** (mbụ), **Then / Next** (mgbe ahụ), **After that** (mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị), **Finally** (n'ikpeazụ), ị ga-amata usoro ihe mere.

en-h1-l1.title: Oge zuru ezu na oge zuru ezu na-aga n'ihu
en-h1-l1.concept: had + p.p. bụ ihe mere tupu oge gara aga, have been -ing bụ omume na-aga n'ihu ruo ugbu a.

en-h1-l2.title: Relative adverb na nominal clause
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why bụ okwu ntụnyere na-arụ ọrụ dị ka adverb, ebe whether / that na-ebute nominal clause.

en-h1-l3.title: Participial construction
en-h1-l3.concept: Wepụ okwu njikọ na okwu isi, gbanwee ngwaa ka ọ bụrụ -ing. Okwu isi n'ihe ọ pụtara ga-adị otu.

en-h1-l4.title: Okwu njikọ na ọsọ ederede
en-h1-l4.concept: Kewaa ihe kpatara–nsonaazụ (so, therefore), ihe megidere (however), ọmụmaatụ (for example), na mgbakwunye (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Ịghọta isi ihe na ịtụpụta ebe tọgbọrọ chakoo
en-h1-l5.concept: Isi ihe dị n'akụkụ However gaa n'ihu nke na-agbanwe echiche ndị mmadụ na-ejikarị, na n'ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ. Tụpụta ebe tọgbọrọ chakoo site n'usoro nsogbu → ngwọta → nsonaazụ.

en-h2-l1.title: Inversion na ahịrịokwu mmesi ike
en-h2-l1.concept: Mgbe Never/Hardly/Only then dị na mmalite ahịrịokwu, usoro bụ ngwaa enyemaka + okwu isi. Jiri It is ~ that mee mmesi ike.

en-h2-l2.title: Subjunctive
en-h2-l2.concept: N'ahịrịokwu I wish / as if / If, jiri ụdị oge gara aga maka ihe megidere ugbu a, ma jiri had p.p. maka ihe megidere oge gara aga.

en-h2-l3.title: Compound relative na concessive clause
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever, however + adjective pụtara 'ọ bụla ... ma ọ bụ n'agbanyeghị ka ... dị'.

en-h2-l4.title: Okwu n'ọnọdụ ederede
en-h2-l4.concept: Tụpụta ihe okwu ọhụrụ pụtara site na ihe ngosi nke ihe megidere, ọmụmaatụ na ihe kpatara, na prefix.

en-h2-l5.title: Ịga n'ihu nke ezi uche n'ederede
en-h2-l5.concept: Soro ọsọ ederede site na ihe okwu ntụ aka na-ezo aka na ya na okwu njikọ, ma chịkọta ozi nkọwa ka ị nweta ọgwụgwụ.

en-h3-l1.title: Parallel structure na nkwekọrịta
en-h3-l1.concept: Okwu ndị a jikọtara site na and/but/or ga-adị n'otu ụdị, ngwaa ga-ekwekọrịta na isi okwu isi.

en-h3-l2.title: Mmetụta uche, ụdị olu na ebumnuche
en-h3-l2.concept: Chọpụta mmetụta uche site n'okwu nkọwa na mmetụta, ma chọpụta ebumnuche ederede site n'ịlele ma ọ na-arịọ, na-enye ntụziaka, ma ọ bụ na-eme ka mmadụ kwenye.

en-h3-l3.title: Usoro ahịrịokwu na itinye ahịrịokwu
en-h3-l3.concept: Jiri okwu njikọ, okwu ntụ aka na usoro oge dị ka ihe ngosi hazie ahịrịokwu ma chọta ebe ahịrịokwu e nyere kwesịrị itinye.

en-h3-l4.title: Collocation na nkwupụta ndị a na-ejikarị
en-h3-l4.concept: Mụta ụzọ okwu ndị na-eso ibe ha dị ka make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain, ma tụpụta ihe nkwupụta ndị a na-ejikarị pụtara site n'ọnọdụ.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = oke ntachi obi nke ikpeazụ

en-h3-l5.title: Imecha nchịkọta
en-h3-l5.concept: Chọta echiche isi na nkwupụta ihe megidere n'ederede ma belata ya n'otu ahịrịokwu.

en-h3e-l1.title: Ịhọrọ ihe kwesịrị n'ọnọdụ
en-h3e-l1.concept: N'ajụjụ mkparịta ụka, ọ dị mkpa ịlele ma ụtọasụsụ ziri ezi yana ma ụdị okwu dị mma ma na-akwanyere ùgwù n'ọnọdụ ahụ. Aro, ịbanye n'okwu, ịzaghachi otuto, nkwupụta a na-ejikarị, na ikwu okwu n'ụzọ na-adịghị ozugbo na-apụta ugboro ugboro.

en-h3e-l2.title: Okwu ọrụ na collocation
en-h3e-l2.concept: Isi ihe n'Bekee ọrụ bụ nkwupụta a na-ejikarị (touch base), mkpụmkpụ okwu (ASAP wdg), na ụzọ ngwaa na preposition si abịa ọnụ (collocation). Atụgharịla okwu site n'okwu; cheta ha dị ka nchikota a na-eji n'ọnọdụ ọrụ.

en-h3e-l3.title: Ịgụ ozi n'ụzọ nyocha
en-h3e-l3.concept: N'Bekee mgbasa ozi, ọ dị mkpa ịkewa eziokwu na echiche, ma lelee ma echiche e ji kwuo nkwupụta ziri ezi. Cheta okwu dị ka nkọwa onyonyo (alt text, caption) ma ọ bụ ngwa ndezi site n'ebumnuche ha.

en-h3e-l4.title: Okwu omenala na obi mepere emepe
en-h3e-l4.concept: N'isiokwu omenala ụwa, mụta okwu isi dị ka culture, diversity, stereotype, na nkwupụta ndị na-achọ ịghọta omenala ndị ọzọ n'enweghị ikpe ha. Jiri ihe ngosi n'ọnọdụ okwu kewaa okwu ndị yiri ibe ha n'ihe ha pụtara.

en-h3e-l5.title: Ịgụ ọrụ site n'okwu ọdịnihu
en-h3e-l5.concept: Isi ihe n'ajụjụ ọdịnihu bụ ịmara nkọwa okwu ma tinye ya n'ọnọdụ dị n'akụkọ. Kewaa ihe ndị a: ihe ịrịba ama n'ihu, akara, echiche nke onye na-akọ, isiokwu, na ọrụ nke àgwà.

en-h3e-l6.title: Ịchọpụta ihe akaebe na njehie
en-h3e-l6.concept: N'arụmụka, ị chọrọ ike ịkewa okwu (motion, rebuttal wdg), ụdị ihe akaebe, na njehie ezi uche. Mgbe ị na-enyocha nkwupụta, buru ụzọ jụọ 'gịnị bụ ihe akaebe nke okwu a?'

en-h3e-l7.title: Ide ihe nke ziri ezi na kwekọrọ n'ebumnuche
en-h3e-l7.concept: N'ide ihe, họrọ ụdị kwesịrị ebumnuche ederede na onye na-agụ ya, ma lelee akụkụ ahịrịokwu (okwu isi na ngwaa) na ezi uche nke okwu njikọ. Ederede doro anya dị ka resume na-ele ihe ndị a na-eme na ọnụọgụ anya karịa okwu na-edoghị anya.

en-l1.title: Mụta okwu kwa ụbọchị
en-l1.concept: Okwu ndị a na-ejikarị bụ ndị ị ga-echeta ogologo oge ma ị mụta **ụda + ihe ọ pụtara + ide** ọnụ. Pịa bọtịnị okwu ka ị nụ olu.
en-l1.example: library = ụlọakwụkwọ akwụkwọ / desk = tebụl / milk = mmiri ara ehi

en-l2.title: Ngwaa be: am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Ngwaa be na-agbanwe n'ụdị dabere n'okwu isi. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.

en-l3.title: Ngwaa nkịtị n'oge ugbu a
en-l3.concept: Mgbe okwu isi bụ **he / she / it (onye nke atọ, otu)**, tinye **-s / -es** na ngwaa. Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-akwụsị na -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o, tinye -es; ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ consonant+y, gbanwee y ka ọ bụrụ i tinyekwa -es!

en-l4.title: Ọtụtụ na ịhazi ahịrịokwu
en-l4.concept: Mgbe mkpọaha karịrị otu, a na-etinyekarị **-s**, ọ bụrụ na ọ na-akwụsị na -x tinye **-es**, ma ọtụtụ na-adịghị n'usoro ka a ga-echeta nke ọ bụla. Usoro ahịrịokwu bụ **okwu isi → ngwaa → fọdụrụnụ**.

en-m2-l1.title: Present perfect
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + past participle. Ọ na-egosi ahụmahụ, ihe zuru ezu, na ihe na-aga n'ihu, ma kewaa since (oge ebe) na for (ogologo oge).

en-m2-l2.title: Passive voice
en-m2-l2.concept: be + past participle na-egosi 'a na-eme ya / ọ na-eche ya'. Tinye onye na-eme ihe site na by.

en-m2-l3.title: To-infinitive na gerund
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V pụtara ebumnuche, stop + V-ing pụtara ịkwụsị.

en-m2-l4.title: Comparative na superlative
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est na more/most. Jiri than na comparative, jiri the na superlative. good → better → best bụ ndị na-adịghị n'usoro.

en-m2-l5.title: Ịgụ: isiokwu na nkọwa
en-m2-l5.concept: Buru ụzọ gụọ ajụjụ ma chọta ahịrịokwu ngosi. Aha na isi ihe bụ ihe na-ekpuchi ederede dum.

en-m2-sum1.title: Ịchịkọta ihe dị n'ederede
en-m2-sum1.concept: Mgbe ị na-achịkọta ederede, chọta **isi ihe** ma belata ya n'otu ma ọ bụ abụọ ahịrịokwu. Ahịrịokwu na-ekwu naanị otu nkọwa, na-agbakwunye ihe na-adịghị n'ederede, ma ọ bụ sara mbara nke ukwuu abụghị ezi nchịkọta.

en-m3-l1.title: Mkpọaha ntụnyere
en-m3-l1.concept: Jiri who (mmadụ), which (ihe), that (ha abụọ), whose (nwe ihe) jikọta ahịrịokwu abụọ ka ha bụrụ otu.

en-m3-l2.title: Ahịrịokwu ọnọdụ na subjunctive oge gara aga
en-m3-l2.concept: If + oge ugbu a, will + V (ihe nwere ike ime). If + oge gara aga, would + V (echiche na-emegide ugbu a).

en-m3-l3.title: Ajụjụ na-adịghị ozugbo
en-m3-l3.concept: Dee ya n'usoro okwu ajụjụ + okwu isi + ngwaa. Ejila do/does/did.

en-m3-l4.title: Participle
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing bụ ọrụ na-aga n'ihu, -ed bụ ihe e meworo ma ọ bụ mezuru. Maka mmetụta, ọ bụrụ na ọ na-akpata ya, jiri -ing; ọ bụrụ na ị na-enwe ya, jiri -ed.

en-m3-l5.title: Ịgụ ihe: Ịkọwa na Ebumnuche Ederede
en-m3-l5.concept: Jikọta ihe ngosi iji kọwaa, ma chọpụta ebumnuche ederede site n'ịlele arịrịọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta.

Tụnyere eziokwu bụ na 'onye ọ bụla na-eme ya' bụ ihe e ji akwado nkwupụta ahụ na ihe aha njehie ọ bụla pụtara.

e-h3e-debate-2.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ The park, which opened in May, covers four hectares. Ọ nwere naanị eziokwu enwere ike ịlele: oge e meghere ya na ukwuu ala ya. best thing the council has ever done bụ nlele n'uche, ya mere ọ bụ echiche onye.
hints: Ahịrịokwu nke eziokwu nwere naanị ozi onye ọbụla nwere ike ịlele, ma ọ nweghị nlele ma ọ bụ mmetụta.
Chọta okwu dị ka wonderful, fool, best n'ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla, bụ okwu na-egosi nlele ma ọ bụ mmetụta.

e-h3e-debate-3.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ motion. Ọ bụ nkwupụta bụ isiokwu mkparịta ụka. rebuttal bụ mgbagha megide nzube onye ọzọ, ya mere ọ bụghị isiokwu ahụ n'onwe ya.
hints: Kewaa okwu mkparịta ụka site n'ọrụ okwu ahụ na-arụ n'mkparịta ụka.
Tụnyere ihe ‘nkwupụta otu abụọ na-arụ ụka ya’ pụtara na okwu ndị pụtara mgbagha, ikpe, ma ọ bụ ndekọ.

e-h3e-debate-4.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ Statistical evidence. Nke a bụ n'ihi na ọnụọgụgụ ahụ sitere n'ịjụ ọtụtụ mmadụ ajụjụ. Anecdotal evidence bụ ahụmahụ onwe nke otu mmadụ ma ọ bụ mmadụ abụọ, ya mere ọ dị iche na nyocha a.
hints: Kewaa ụdị akaebe site n'isi mmalite ozi: okwu ọkachamara, ahụmahụ onwe, nchepụta, ọnụọgụgụ, na ndị ọzọ.
Lee ka nha ndị a jụrụ (mmadụ 2000) na pasent (64%) si egosi ụdị akaebe ahụ.

e-h3e-debate-5.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ persuasive. Mgbe be-verb gasịrị, ọ bụ ebe nkọwa na-akọwa isiokwu, ya mere nkọwaaha na-abịa ebe ahụ. persuasively bụ nkọwangwaa, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịkọwa ihe speech ahụ bụ.
hints: buru ụzọ chọpụta ụdị okwu dị n'oghere. Usoro okwu n'ihu na azụ chọrọ ụdị okwu olee?
Lelee ma ‘was highly ___’ bụ ebe a na-akọwa isiokwu speech, wee họrọ ụdị okwu kwesịrị ebe ahụ.

e-h3e-debate-d1.explanation: Ọ jụrị atụmatụ ahụ n'ihi omume Lena gara aga, ọ bụghị n'ihi ihe atụmatụ ahụ kwuru, ya mere ọ bụ ad hominem (ịwakpo onye). straw man bụ ịgbagọ nzube onye ọzọ wee wakpo ya, mana ebe a ọ gbagọghị atụmatụ ahụ.
hints: Maka ajụjụ nghọta ezighi ezi, buru ụzọ lee ihe a na-akatọ. Ọ bụ nzube n'onwe ya, ka ọ bụ ihe ọzọ? Nke a ga-eme ka ụdị ahụ dị warara.
Lee ma onye na-ekwu okwu na-arụrịta ụka banyere ihe Lena's recycling proposal nwere, ka ọ na-eji eziokwu ọzọ banyere Lena.

e-h3e-job-1.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi pụtara ịkpọtụrụ ibe ya nwa oge ma kọọrọ ibe ya ọnọdụ. touch base bụ ikpọtụrụ ibe ya nkenke iji kekọrịta ozi ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ọganihu. Ọ bụrụ na okwu base eme ka ị chee banyere egwuregwu, ị ga-ezughị.
hints: Okwu ọrụ dị ka idiom na-agbagwoju anya ma ọ bụrụ na a sụgharịa ya okwu n'okwu. Buru ụzọ chee n'ọnọdụ ọrụ ọ na-eji.
Lee na onye ọrụ ibe ya kwuru ‘next week’, na ihe a na-atụ aro ka ndị mmadụ abụọ na-eme n'mkparịta ụka ọrụ.

e-h3e-job-2.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ postponed. Ọ pụtara ịkwaga oge n'azụ, ya mere ọ dabara na until next Monday. finished pụtara na nzukọ agwụla, ya mere ọ dabaghị na ‘ruo Mọnde na-abịa’.
hints: Lee ihe ihe kpatara na oge dị n'ahịrịokwu nwere oghere na-akpata.
Lelee ma mgbanwe oge ahụ dabara na ihe kpatara (onye njikwa ahụ na-arịa ọrịa) na oge njedebe (ruo Mọnde na-abịa).

e-h3e-job-3.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ out. run out of bụ okwu pụtara ‘ihe agwụla’. away na off nwere ike ịbịakọ na run, mana ha adịghị eme ihe a pụtara mgbe of na-esochi.
hints: Chee ihe running n'ihu oghere, of n'azụ, na printer paper n'azụ of na-egosi ọnụ. Tinye okwu anọ ahụ otu n'otu, gụọ ya n'olu, wee lee ma 'running ___ of ...' na-ada ụda nkịtị dị ka otu ngọngọ.
Site n'ihe kpatara eji gwa ya ka o nye iwu ịzụta akwụkwọ ọzọ n'ahịrịokwu na-esote, chee ka ọnọdụ akwụkwọ ahụ dị.

e-h3e-job-4.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ at. Ọ bụ be good at ~ing, nke na-ekwu banyere ikike. good of na-eji ekele omume mmadụ, dị ka ‘n'obi ọma’, ya mere ọ bụghị okwu ikike.
hints: Lelee ihe nrụpụta (preposition) na-abịa mgbe nkọwaaha good gasịrị dị ka collocation.
Ebe ọ bụ na solving (gerund) na-esote, chọta nrụpụta e ji ekwu ikike ‘ịma ime ihe nke ọma’.

e-h3e-job-5.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ for your information. Ọ pụtara ‘a na-ekele gị ka ị mara’, a na-ejikarị ya n'email. for your invitation kwụ F na Y n'ụzọ ziri ezi, mana I bụ invitation, ya mere ihe ọ pụtara agbanwela.
hints: Gbasaa mkpụrụedemede dị ka mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke okwu, wee lelee ma ọ dabara n'ebumnuche e ji tinye ya n'isi ozi.
Ebumnuche ya bụ ịgwa onye ọzọ ihe n'isi ozi. Tụnyere okwu kwekọrọ na F, Y, I n'ime nhọrọ ndị ahụ.

e-h3e-job-d1.explanation: Okwu person nke dị n'azụ ohere efu bụ mkpọaha, ya mere nkọwaaha reliable (nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi) bụ nke ziri ezi. Reliably bụ adverb, ya mere ọ pụghị ịkọwa mkpọaha.
hints: Okwu anọ ahụ si n'otu mgbọrọgwụ pụta, ya mere akụkụ okwu bụ isi ihe karịa ihe ha pụtara. Buru ụzọ chọpụta ọrụ ohere efu ahụ rụrụ n'ahịrịokwu.
Lee akụkụ okwu nke okwu dị n'azụ ohere efu ahụ, ma chee akụkụ okwu na-akọwa ya.

e-h3e-lit-1.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ foreshadowing (ngosipụta tupu oge). Ọ bụ ngwaọrụ na-egosi ihe ga-eme ma e mesịa. Flashback bụ ịla azụ n'ihe gara aga, ya mere ọ bụghị ngosipụta nke ihe ga-eme.
hints: Maka okwu ede akwụkwọ, chetakwuo nkọwa ya ma tinye ya n'usoro ihe omume. Kedu oge n'akụkọ ka ngwaọrụ a na-arụ ọrụ?
Lee usoro n'etiti oge a kpọtụrụ aha na akwa ahụ na-adịghị ike na oge akwa ahụ dara.

e-h3e-lit-2.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ peace (udo). Nduru ọcha bụ akara ọdịnala nke udo n'akwụkwọ. Danger (ihe egwu) adabaghị n'ọnọdụ ebe agha kwụsịrị.
hints: N'abụ, anụmanụ ma ọ bụ ihe nwere ike bụrụ akara. Jikọọ ya na mmetụta nke ebe ọ pụtara.
Chee ihe ndị mmadụ na-achọ mgbe agha gasịrị, ma chọta okwu kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ahụ.

e-h3e-lit-3.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ echiche omniscient (onye maara ihe niile), n'ihi na onye na-akọ akụkọ maara echiche ọtụtụ ndị. Echiche limited na-egosi naanị echiche otu onye, ya mere ọ dabaghị n'ọmụmaatụ ebe echiche mmadụ abụọ pụtara.
hints: Maka ajụjụ banyere echiche, lee onye na-ekwu okwu na ole mmadụ ka onye na-akọ akụkọ maara echiche ha.
Lee ma ọmụmaatụ ahụ na-akọwa echiche Anna na Tom abụọ, ma họrọ echiche kwekọrọ n'oke ahụ.

e-h3e-lit-4.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ Kindness often comes back to those who give it. Ọ na-ekwu ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ n'akụkọ dị ka echiche izugbe banyere ndụ. The story takes place in a market bụ naanị nkọwa ebe, ọ bụghị isiokwu.
hints: Isiokwu abụghị atụmatụ akụkọ ma ọ bụ ebe, kama ọ bụ echiche izugbe akụkọ ahụ nwere banyere ndụ.
Lee ma ahịrịokwu ahụ na-eme izugbe mmekọrịta n'etiti omume nwatakịrị ahụ na nsonaazụ ya, ma ọ naghị emegide akụkọ ahụ.

e-h3e-lit-5.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ protagonist (onye bụ isi n'akụkọ). Ọ nọ n'etiti akụkọ, nwee ebumnuche, ma na-eduga ihe omume. Antagonist bụ onye na-emegide protagonist, ya mere ọrụ ya dị iche.
hints: Ndị a na-ekewa okwu banyere ihe odide site n'ọrụ ha. Onye bụ isi, onye na-emegide, na onye na-akọ akụkọ dị iche.
Tụnyere nkọwa ‘wants something and drives the action’ n'ajụjụ ahụ na nkọwa okwu nke nhọrọ ọ bụla.

e-h3e-lit-d1.explanation: Usoro nke mkpụrụokwu a na-ekwusi ike na nke a na-ekwusighị ike na-agbagharị n'usoro bụ rhythm (meter). Plot structure bụ usoro ihe omume, ọ nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ụda.
hints: Were okwu nke nkọwa ahụ (stressed and unstressed syllables, regular pattern) kọwaa n'otu ahịrịokwu, wee họrọ nhọrọ kwekọrọ na ya.
Mgbe stressed na unstressed syllables na-agbanwe n'ọnụ, kedu ka ọ ga-adị ka e kwuru ya? Chọta okwu na-egosi mmetụta ahụ.

e-h3e-media-1.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ ịkọwa onyonyo maka ndị na-apụghị ịhụ ya. Ederede ọzọ (alt text) na-agwa ndị na-eji ihe na-agụ ihuenyo ihe dị n'onyonyo, ma ọ bụ mgbe onyonyo anaghị egosi. Igbochi nbipute bụ ọrụ nke teknụzụ ọzọ.
hints: Tụgharịa aha okwu ahụ. Alt bụ mkpirisi nke alternative (ọzọ).
Chee onye na n'ọnọdụ ole ka ọrụ a na-enyere aka, ma buru ụzọ wepụ nhọrọ ndị dị anya n'ebumnuche.

e-h3e-media-2.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ The new park is the most beautiful place in town. ‘Kasị mara mma’ bụ ntụle dị iche n'ebe mmadụ nọ, ya mere ọ bụ echiche. Ọnwa mepere, nha ebe, na ọnụọgụgụ ebe egwuregwu bụ eziokwu enwere ike inyocha.
hints: Eziokwu enwere ike inyocha, ma echiche dị iche n'ebe mmadụ nọ. Lee ma a pụrụ inyocha ahịrịokwu ọ bụla.
Lee ma ọ bụ ozi enwere ike inyocha dị ka ụbọchị, nha, ma ọ bụ ọnụọgụgụ, ma ọ bụ ma ọ nwere okwu ntụle.

e-h3e-media-3.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ na ọ na-eche na tii ahụ bụ ihe kpatara ahụike ya ka mma. Naanị na ọ dị mma mgbe e richara tii apụtaghị na tii kpatara ya. formal style bụ naanị ụdị ide ihe, ọ bụghị adịghị ike nke echiche.
hints: Were otu ahịrị chịkọta ka mgbasa ozi a si site n'ihe akaebe gaa n'ihe ọ kwubiri. Wee jụọ onwe gị ma naanị akaebe ahụ ezuola ịkwado nkwubi okwu ahụ. Lelee ma nhọrọ ahụ na-ekwu maka njikọ echiche, ka ọ bụ naanị ọdịdị ederede.
Lekwasị anya n'otu e si jikọọ ịṅụ tii na ịka mma wee kwubie, wee wepụ nhọrọ ndị na-ekwu maka okwu ma ọ bụ ụdị ide ihe.

e-h3e-media-4.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ Students gather with balloons at the annual school fair. Ụmụ akwụkwọ, bọlụụn na emume ụlọ akwụkwọ dabara n'ihe e gosiri n'foto ahụ niile. Nhọrọ dị ka onye na-agba ọsọ nanị ya na-agafe akara njedebe dị iche kpamkpam n'foto ahụ.
hints: Okwu ntụgharị n'okpuru foto ga-akọwa ndị mmadụ, ebe na ihe a na-eme nke a pụrụ ịhụ n'ezie n'foto ahụ.
Buru ụzọ dee ndị mmadụ, ebe na ngwa dị n'ọnọdụ ahụ e kwuru n'ajụjụ ahụ, wee tụnyere ha na nhọrọ nke ọ bụla.

e-h3e-media-5.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ Track changes. Ọ na-egosi mgbanwe ka e gosi aro mgbazi n'ememe ọ na-ehichaghị ederede mbụ. Print preview bụ naanị ihe na-ebu ụzọ egosi ọdịdị mbipụta, ya mere ọ nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na aro mgbazi.
hints: Chịkọta ihe a chọrọ. A ga-atụ aro mgbazi mana ederede mbụ agaghị ehichapụ.
Lelee ma nhọrọ ọ bụla metụtara idezigharị akwụkwọ, ma ọ bụrụ otú ahụ, ọ na-echekwa ederede mbụ ma na-egosi mgbanwe.

e-h3e-media-d1.explanation: echo chamber pụtara otu ìgwè nke na-anụ naanị echiche dị ka nke ha, nke mere na echiche ha na-esiwanye ike. Ụlọ mkparịta ụka nke na-emegharị ozi ugboro abụọ bụ naanị ịmegharị ụda ma ọ bụ ederede, ọ nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ọgbaghara echiche.
hints: echo chamber abụghị ụlọ n'ezie, kama ọ bụ okwu ịkọwa ihe site n'ihe ọzọ. Tụlee ihe n'ịntanetị dabara n'ụda na-ada ụda.
Chee ihe na-alọghachi ugboro ugboro dị ka mgbamgba, wee mata nhọrọ na-ekwu maka ụda n'onwe ya na nke na-ekwu maka echiche ndị mmadụ.

e-h3e-world-1.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ asụsụ ndị mmadụ nwere asụsụ nne dị iche iche na-eji. Ọrụ Bekee n'ọkwa mgbasa ozi mba ụwa bụ ọmụmaatụ ya. Asụsụ naanị otu ezinụlọ na-eji enweghị ike ịbụ asụsụ nkịtị.
hints: Ghara iwe ụjọ ọ bụrụ na okwu Latin a amaghị gị. Buru ụzọ tụnyere otú nhọrọ ọ bụla si akọwa 'onye na-asụ asụsụ ahụ', wee wepụ nhọrọ nwere ọnọdụ dị warawara ma ọ bụ dị ọhụrụ.
Tụnyere onye na-asụ asụsụ ahụ na mmekọrịta ha n'ime nhọrọ ọ bụla.

e-h3e-world-2.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ stereotype. Ọ pụtara nkwenye dị mfe nke ukwuu banyere otu ìgwè niile. dialect pụtara okwu mpaghara, ya mere ọ bụghị nkwenye banyere ndị mmadụ.
hints: N'ajụjụ ọnọdụ okwu, họrọ okwu isi. oversimplified na whole group bụ igodo.
Buru ụzọ kewaa okwu nhọrọ ọ bụla n'ime echiche banyere ìgwè, ụzọ okwu, emume, ma ọ bụ ezinụlọ.

e-h3e-world-3.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ diversity. cultural diversity pụtara ọdịiche omenala. division pụtara 'nkewa', nke megidere nkọwa 'ha na-ebikọ ọnụ'.
hints: Maka okwu ndị yiri ibe ha n'ide, jiri nkọwa dị n'azụ oghere ahụ tụnyere ihe ha pụtara.
Tụnyere nkọwa na-ekwu na ndị si n'azụ dị iche iche na-ebikọ ọnụ na nkọwa nke aha na-esote cultural n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị.

e-h3e-world-4.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ Their customs are different from ours, and I would like to learn why. Ọ bụ àgwà ịnabata ọdịiche na ịchọ ịmụ. Okwu dị ka strange and backward na-eweda omenala ndị ọzọ ala.
hints: N'ajụjụ nghọta omenala, lelee ma onye ahụ na-ekpe ikpe omenala ndị ọzọ ka ọ na-achọ ịghọta ha.
Lelee ma okwu dị ka all, wrong, backward na-agbasa ikpe n'ozuzu ma ọ bụ na-ekewa ndị mmadụ n'elu na ala.

e-h3e-world-5.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ authentic. Ọ pụtara 'nke ezi, nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi'. artificial pụtara ihe mmadụ rụpụtara nke adịghị adị n'ezie, ya mere ọ bụ ihe megidere ya.
hints: Gbanwee okwu isi nke nkọwa, genuine, n'okwu dị mfe.
Chee ihe bụ ihe megidere 'not copied', wee buru ụzọ wepụ nhọrọ nwere ihe ahụ pụtara.

e-h3e-world-d1.explanation: indigenous pụtara ihe sitere na mbụ biri n'otu mpaghara, ihe nke ala ahụ n'onwe ya. foreign pụtara ihe sitere n'obodo ọzọ, ya mere ọ bụ n'ezie ihe megidere ya.
hints: Gụọ nkọwa ahụ, jide isi ihe ọ pụtara, wee tụnyere ya na ihe okwu ọ bụla pụtara otu otu.
Lekwasị anya na akụkụ “the first people who lived in a region”. Chọta okwu ndị metụtara ọnọdụ ebe a na-eche, oge, ma ọ bụ ebe mmadụ si, nke dabara na ihe a pụtara.

e-h3e-write-1.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ makes. 'make a case for' bụ collocation guzosiri ike pụtara 'ịkọwa arụmụka na-akwado ihe', ya mere ọ dabara nke ọma mgbe report na-ekwu arụmụka site n'ihe àmà. does bụ ngwaa n'ozuzu, ọ naghị ejikọ ya na 'a case for', ya mere ọ dị ihe ọjọọ n'ịgụ.
hints: Cheta ejikọ ngwaa na aha dị ka otu, ọ bụghị naanị site n'ihe ha pụtara. Chee ngwaa ejiri na a case.
Tụnyere ngwaa ndị na-ejikọkarị na case n'echiche nke 'ịkọwa' arụmụka nke report.

e-h3e-write-2.explanation: Azịza ziri ezi bụ Organized a school recycling campaign that collected 300 kilograms of paper. Ọ na-amalite site na ngwaa ma na-egosi ihe e mere na nsonaazụ nke ọnụọgụ. Helped with various things ... anaghị egosi ihe e mere.
hints: Resume na-egosi nsonaazụ n'ụzọ doro anya ma dị mkpụmkpụ. Zere okwu na-enweghị nkọwa doro anya.
Tụnyere ma nhọrọ ọ bụla na-ekwu banyere ihe a kpọmkwem e mere, ka ọ bụ naanị echiche onwe onye ma ọ bụ nkọwa na-enweghị nkọwa doro anya.
